1.Nf3 f6 2.e4 Nh6.strategy: Puts the knight on the rim because f6 is taken by its own pawn. White's d-pawn opens the queen's bishop against the knight at once, and Bxh6 would wreck Black's kingside pawns, so Black loses time before the position is even equal.

1.Nf3 f6 2.e4 Nh6 3.d4.strategy: Takes a second central pawn and opens the queen's bishop against the knight on h6: Bxh6 gxh6 would double Black's pawns. White builds the centre with tempo while Black's knight has to retreat.
